replies.text: Noted: your shop is in Brooklyn, New York.
Got it: your customers love Glossier, Aesop and Phoebe Bridgers.
Quick check: by "Le Labo" do you mean Le Labo Fragrances? (Le Labo Fragrances is a niche perfume and candle brand known for hand-formulated perfumes, slow perfumery, …)

Drop #01 is ready: 9 to stock, 2 to consider, 10 to skip. Top picks: Le Labo, Boy Smells, Girlfriend Collective and Baggu. A generic bestseller list would have made the opposite call on Boy Smells, Baggu, Otherland, Fjällräven and Hydro Flask. That is where your crowd differs from the average shopper.
